verdict.rationale: Otter documents its own mobile app: the Android app can record, transcribe, and give access to meetings on the go, and a community user confirms recording in the iOS app. Otter also documents searching transcripts across meetings and through AI Chat. However, the evidence never explicitly addresses in-person conversations or confirms that mobile recordings sync into the same searchable workspace as other meetings; that link is only implied by "access your meetings". missing for 10: explicit documentation of in-person conversation capture, explicit confirmation that mobile recordings land in the shared searchable workspace/Channels, first-party iOS app documentation, independent hands-on corroboration of mobile-to-workspace search.

support.subject: As a founder, I can record and transcribe in-person conversations from a mobile app, and those notes land in the same searchable workspace

citations.quote: Record, transcribe, and access your meetings on the go with the Otter Android app
Search your meeting transcripts across all time periods
Otter AI Chat searches across your meetings and connected apps
recent UI changes that made the record/stop button tiny in the iOS app
